description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Mid Year Fiscal Position Report 2017 issued under section 10 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 03 of 2003
categorisation: This gazette content announces the availability of the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report 2017, which is issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 03 of 2003. The content focuses on regulatory compliance with a specific legal framework (Section 10 of the Act) and provides information about statutory reporting requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it pertains to regulatory frameworks and compliance with existing legislation, rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
